# Feature: Screen consenting customers' orders for fraud

Every order of a customer who consented is screened by Northwind Pay before stock is reserved, and
only the customer's own token may place an order.

## Flows

- forge-orders.place-order (changed): the consent check, the screen and the narrower rule of who
  may place an order go before stock is reserved.
- forge-stock.reserve-stock (read): reserving stock happens only after the screen passes.
